n: The Bensberg Town Hall in Bergisch Gladbach (1971) is by Gottfried Böhm, the 1986 laureate, who also designed the Pilgrimage Church of Mary, Queen of Peace, in Neviges (1968).

q: Which of these is a work of Kevin Roche?
o: The Glass House in New Canaan, Connecticut
The Ford Foundation Building in New York
n: The Ford Foundation Building in New York (1968) is by Kevin Roche, the 1982 laureate. The others: the Glass House in New Canaan, Connecticut (1949) is by Philip Johnson; Lever House in New York (1952) is by Gordon Bunshaft; Guild House in Philadelphia (1963) is by Robert Venturi.
ref: Pritzker Architecture Prize — Laureates, 1982: Kevin Roche

q: Which Pritzker laureate designed the Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library at Yale?
n: The Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library at Yale (1963) is by Gordon Bunshaft, the 1988 laureate, who also designed Lever House in New York (1952).

q: Which of these is a work of I. M. Pei?
n: The Louvre Pyramid in Paris (1989, after the 1983 prize) is by I. M. Pei, the 1983 laureate. The others: the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park (1955) is by Kenzo Tange; the Spiral building in Tokyo (1985) is by Fumihiko Maki; the Ningbo History Museum (2008) is by Wang Shu.
ref: Pritzker Architecture Prize — Laureates, 1983: I. M. Pei

q: Which Pritzker laureate designed the National Congress of Brazil in Brasília?

q: Which of these is a work of Hans Hollein?
o: The San Cataldo Cemetery in Modena
The Pilgrimage Church of Mary, Queen of Peace, in Neviges
The Städtisches Museum Abteiberg in Mönchengladbach
The tensile roof of the Munich Olympic Stadium
n: The Städtisches Museum Abteiberg in Mönchengladbach (1982) is by Hans Hollein, the 1985 laureate. The others: the Pilgrimage Church of Mary, Queen of Peace, in Neviges (1968) is by Gottfried Böhm; the San Cataldo Cemetery in Modena (begun 1971, never fully completed) is by Aldo Rossi; the tensile roof of the Munich Olympic Stadium (1972) is by Frei Otto.
